positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
~ Tech Lead for iTunes third party payment integration which supports 3.3M+ users (roughly 33% of all paid subscribers).
~ Spearheaded effort to refactor internal iTunes database, which resulted in a reduction of data stored by 93% and reduced query runtime by 80% while maintaining 100% uptime and availability for clients.
~ Developer and tech lead for migrating VRV subscriptions into Crunchyroll retaining ~$1.2M in monthly revenue once product was sunset.
~ Interim Product Manager and knowledge expert for legal email notifications notifying users of subscription price changes and renewals.
~ Created, updated and maintained unit and integration tests in Golang.
~ Created, updated and maintained technical documentation and runbooks as tech lead on several projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Information Systems Analyst
positions.description:
~ Project Lead/Developer, Knowledge Expert, and Liaison for Whole Person Care, a state-wide initiative to identify high-risk populations through consolidation and analysis of data between disparate systems to coordinate care in real time.
~ Full-stack development, testing, deployment, and continual management/feature implementation of internal web applications to improve efficiency of work flow processes and increase transparency across the Health Care Services Agency.
~ Improved production systems security through LDAP authentication, county firewall, and secure user sessions to provide high-level information protection under HIPAA compliance.

positions.title: Cal Housing Coordinator
positions.description:
~ Built and deployed an online replacement for the department’s manual residential housing tour booking system. Increased bookings by 90% and customer reach by 100% through automation of the process. 
~ Consistently logged, managed, and processed the dynamic student transfer request database (~900 requests).
~ Selected a third-party company for off-campus housing listings to allow for a stable, dependable and efficient housing search system for University students, staff and faculty to use during relocation.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Documentation · Communication · Leadership · Data Collection · System Configuration · Documentation

positions.title: Senior Project Coordinator
positions.description:
~ Led a team of 4 AutoCAD Engineers to achieve 100% success rate meeting high pressure and constantly changing deadlines.
~ Conducted site reviews/inspections to verify contractors accurately and successfully built-out all commercial kitchen plans (Venetian & Wynn, Macau and Raffles, Singapore).
~ Launched internal file tracking application for integrated engineering and construction department use.
~ Accelerated file submittals (via Aconex) by 85% through re-organization of the file storage system and standardized naming protocols.

projects.title: SaFe Route
projects.description:
SaFe Route provides conveniently displayed walking directions on a map overlaid with dynamically queried crime report data. The web app also allows users to filter crime data (by type of crime, day of the week, time of day and/or police district) in a separate map to view crime data in SF as a whole. 
Tech Stack: Python, Javascript/jQuery, Google Maps API, Lyft API, Soda API(SF Open Data), SQLAlchemy
